Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Medical Officer post at TMC HBCHRCV is scheduled for 03 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification for the Medical Officer post is M.B.B.S with Internship completed. One year of work experience after internship is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Medical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Medical Officer position is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Medical Officer post will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 99,000/- to Rs. 1,09,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Medical Officer post at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of these documents, and recent passport-size photographs to the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Medical Officer role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, 530053.
